project_description: We run weekly warehouse KPIs out of three Google Sheets and paste them into Slack by hand. We want that automated into a dashboard plus a Monday morning Slack digest. Leadership asked for this live by the end of the month — it is blocking the Q4 ops review.
We need a simple catering request form on our site that emails the owner and drops a row into a spreadsheet. No rush; sometime this quarter is fine. We are a 12-person bakery in Portland.
